video_title: Back in NYC for the First Time Since Retiring

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the importance of finding fulfillment in the present
quotes.excerpt: If I'm not content or if I'm not happy and fulfilled today, I won't be happy and fulfilled.
quotes.quote: Something that I learned the hard way that if I could go back, I would change for sure. Learning that if I'm not content or if I'm not happy and fulfilled today, I won't be happy and fulfilled if one day I can get to where I want to get to.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the relentless nature of chasing career goals
quotes.excerpt: It's not wrong to have goals, it's not wrong to have dreams, you also work hard.
quotes.quote: It's not wrong to have goals, it's not wrong to have dreams, you also work hard and chase them. But I think if we're not enjoying the journey and if we're not content with who we are today, even if we get to where we want to get to, we won't be content.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin and Steve Novak discuss the 2012 Knicks playoff run
quotes.excerpt: I'm so glad that I didn't realize you were still coming to New York after Game 5.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: I'm so glad that I didn't realize you were still coming to New York after Game 5.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Novak
text_blocks.text: I was in London doing the game for a watch party. We were texting during Game 3 and you were like, 'There might not be a Game 5.' I was like, 'I think there'll probably be a Game 5, Philly's not that bad.'

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the transactional nature of professional basketball
quotes.excerpt: I also don't get paid unless you hit shots.
quotes.quote: As much as my job is to assist you all, I also don't get paid unless you hit shots. Which is basically my way of saying you don't ever have to pay when we eat ever again.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the fashion choices of a retired athlete
quotes.excerpt: Who wears a tux blazer with a turtleneck?
quotes.quote: Somebody came up to me and was like, 'Who wears a tux blazer with a turtleneck?' Apparently that's not a thing, so I'll have to sharpen my outfit for the next event I have.
